About

Data-informed strategy, built for how people actually scroll, click, and buy

I'm an experienced social media manager and creative strategist with 4+ years of proven expertise in driving brand success across fashion, clothing, and event management sectors, as well as institutions, religious organizations, and personal brands.

My strategic approach has empowered diverse clients by developing tailored content, implementing consistency plans, engaging in community management, and delivering impactful video editing. I've delivered a 35% increase in social media engagement, 60% growth in content views, 35% growth in lead generation, and 65% improvement in brand awareness through data-informed content and paid social strategies.

Currently Head of Social Media at EvolveUp, a creative marketing agency, where I lead social and digital strategy for clients across multiple industries, translating business objectives into content, audience growth, engagement, and conversion across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Substack, and YouTube.

Social Media Strategy Content Development Community Management Paid Advertising Campaign Analytics Audience Targeting Influencer Marketing Cross-Functional Collaboration
